title: CJNG after El Mencho
current_phase: The CJNG has been in a leadership succession since El Mencho was killed in February 2026.

history.text: The CJNG rose after 2010 to become one of Mexico's two largest trafficking organizations.

what.text: El País reported in August 2026 that the CJNG had kept operating six months after El Mencho's death.
InSight Crime questioned claims that a single new boss controls the group.

trend.label: Homicide victims per month, Jalisco, Michoacán and Guanajuato
